reviews.title: Worst Airline to ever exist
reviews.text: Do not book with this airline! They left all of their passengers waiting at the gate for 9HOURS without any information from the airline. No contact person, no one who knew what was happening or could help us. We all lost one entire day of our holidays. And when the airplane finally arrived they pretended like it was nothing, 9h left at the airport, no food no drinks no one to help out. On the flight itself the staff ignored the fact that they just had 9h delay and didn’t even offer us food or a reimbursement. A pity that this airline still exists. Really shameful behavior on their side. I do not recommend anyone to fly with them and would honestly advise everyone to make sure to never fly with them again.
reviews.author: Noa H

reviews.title: Horrible experience
reviews.text: Terrible, never again with this company. Narrow seats, cleanliness on board deplorable, there is not even a storage pocket on the front seat. But above all, on a flight of more than 5 hours not even a glass of water is given. You have to buy it for 4 CHF, despite the fact that the flight costs like that of Edelweiss, where you are treated in a very different way. Ah, sure, the CEO of Chair presents it to us as a way to avoid waste. But please...
reviews.author: chge731

reviews.title: No words - worst flight ever
reviews.text: - 9 hours delayed - 10 FR Voucher for Drinks but nothing for food even nothing on the flight - no information about anything - Seats are very small and uncomfortable - You have to pay for anything on this airline (nothing is for free..) We will never fly with this airline again and don‘t recommend it to anybody.
reviews.author: Alex

reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text: Cheap flight, this is ok. Moved it once, check-in not working, 30 mins on the dial and nobody answers. They knew from the beginning that also on the day, the flight had a delay, still not notified. Taken a half a day holiday for nothing.
reviews.author: F V

reviews.title: Flight cancelled and no alternative proposed
reviews.text: Chair airlines cancels it flights and does not propose alternative flights to reach back the destination even if the outbound flight has been done . Chair Airlines does not even care about calling their customers to inform them of the flight cancellation. You just discover it when you try to register to your flight (Mykonos-Zurich) 1 day before. This is not compliant with EU regulation and I will suit CHAIR Airlines with Airhelpsupport.
reviews.author: Julie L

reviews.title: ChairAir, more like NoChair
reviews.text: Was really excited to travel to Zermatt. Bags, check. Passport, check. Covid test, check. I take a 65 minute uber to the airport only to find out that my dreams were CRUSHED. Literally have never been so sad in my life. Apparently it's legal to cancel flights and not notify passengers of the change. I went to the customer service desk and I was greeted by what appeared to be a DMV employee who could not care less and told me the airline is closing through April. Do yourself a favor and learn from my mistakes... pay for an airline that isn't a scam.
reviews.author: Ahmed H

reviews.title: Worth airlines
reviews.text: They was chaos, with our places ,, all is changed and they was tourist doesn't have a place ,,, !!!!! Pity
reviews.author: Adriansamuel

reviews.title: Slavemasters
reviews.text: worst flight experience ever Talked to employees They get treated like slaves and are all very demotivated Calling this a swiss airline is an absolute shame for the country
reviews.author: Josef H

reviews.title: Covid rules optional
reviews.text: I was extremely disappointed by the lack of enforcement of covid rules during my flights. Wearing a mask seemed to be optional once boarding was completed, and on-board staff did not remind/request passengers to wear their masks correctly, even when speaking to them. I therefore had to ask the person sitting in front of me myself to please put on his mask correctly. I can only be glad that the flight was half-empty, as I know now that safety is not a priority for this airline. After this experience, I will not fly with Chair in the future.
reviews.author: SMD

reviews.title: Unfair mistreatment. Poor customer care
reviews.text: I find trip advisor a joke. They say explain your experiences but then send you a email saying don’t tell us about staff and people even though our experience is based on it. am disgusted at the treatment we received by this airline. We left from sharm on Friday 20th in the early afternoon. On the flight me my husband and mother sat on one side, and my father was placed in the seat closest to the centre aisle on the opposite side next to two females. We were the only Indian passengers on the plane. The passenger sitting next to my father in the middle seat every 10-15 minutes made my father get up so she could go either to the toilet or go get her bag (which she then moved under her seat) coming back from the toilet rather than doing what any other human would do is ask my father if he could let her through To Get to her seat grab her bag and do whatever she needed to do, she would make my father get up, lean over to her bag. Take creams and hand sanitizer out and start using it (taking ages) not once during the 20 times she made my father get up did she apologise or have the decency to just sit down but instead she made my father look like a idiot standing there waiting whilst she did her business. That behaviour was disrespectful as if she was belittling us. It got to a point the disrespect was unbearable. My father is a quiet and humble man and would not say anything but I have seen things like this happen before and like any daughter I would not tolerate it. I gently tapped the woman on the back (while my dad already was standing around for 5 minutes whilst she was putting sanitizer on scrambling through her bag) and told her politely if she minded sitting down and doing whatever she needed to do and that she had does this nearly every 10 minutes. She turned and looked at me in disgust and said excuse me. I asked again politely if she would grab her bag and sit down and not make my father stand around like a idiot and she rudely said I am not talking to you tutting and making faces and then she went to go complain the the crew. The crew members then came to me and I explained the situation. No surprise the crew members were just as bad and the air hostess rudely said you should have rang the bell, what’s your problem your father hasn’t got a problem why do you. I found it horrific as she sided with the woman. I explained the situation and explained I politely asked her and said it was disrespectful, my father won’t say anything but I have a problem and the air hostess again rudely said well he doesn’t have a problem and DIDNT care of how we were being treated and said well she’s going to move now and murmured in their own language. This conversation continued by staff amongst themselves in their own language. This was a targeted situation and I want this review to be posted not told to change. This is My experience
reviews.author: SANAV

reviews.title: Chair Airlines is a great company to fly with
reviews.text: Flight was on time and really comfortable, great landing and fine snack. It is a great company to fly with
reviews.author: Martina B

reviews.title: Great website & awesome Costumer Service!
reviews.text: The website is a clean site with a flawless look, and someone without any technical background would definitely appreciate it. Very easy to navigate if you want to book a ticket or get any information that you need. The support I received through the Service Center of this airline was amazing. My issue was resolved within a few hours and I got feedback immediately after that.
reviews.author: Doki Q

reviews.title: Some really great flight attendants but not everything is good
reviews.text: Summary: some better and some worse flight attendants but a poor booking system It started on baggage drop. I had booked and payed for diving luggage, but the payment was not noted in the system, so they wanted to charge me a second time. I could produce proof of payment on my mobile. But I do not understand, why I have to. Their system really should know. Also: no way to save your boarding pass on the mobile upon online check-in. Just PDFs. Their booking system is just not up to the 21st century. The flight to Sharm was rather good, two nice female flight assistants. But then, the only male aboard (this was on Dec 6, 2019) handed out the entry forms required in Egypt. I didn't have a pen, so I asked him whether I could borrow his. With a bright smile he pointed to his pen and said "this is mine, but you are not going to have it". Afterwards, the ladies where selling goods and I asked them whether I could buy a pen. They were amazed, took out their pen, told me that it was a private one and that they needed it back. What a difference to the arrogant male flight attendant. On the flight back, we had incredibly nice flight attendants!
reviews.author: simue

reviews.title: Perfect, Fantastic, Much Better than I expected, I will fly Chair airlines again!
reviews.text: What a great and simple experience on Chair Airlines. I was hesitant at first because I could not find much about the airline, but wow they were great! I highly recommend this airline and would fly them many more times. The flight was on time, the staff and service was so friendly and nice, the employees really were helpful and the flight was fantastic. It was a nice airbus, got us to Beirut right on time and even offered great in flight meal service. Fantastic Airline, thank you CHAIR!
reviews.author: Christopher K

reviews.title: Unreliable flight times, no compensation - stay away
reviews.text: Chair airlines moved my flight time from ZRH to BEY by 7 hours in advance (1:20PM to 06:20 AM) with no explanation. This lead me to lose the entire value of my ticket, as I couldn’t have reached the airport on time in the morning. Their customer service didn’t do anything, and instead “explained” that they had already changed the flight’s time once before I booked (?), merely underscoring their unreliability... Take my advice and stay away from Chair, worth paying a proper airline a bit more but to instead get to the destination you paid for at the time you paid for...
reviews.author: Julius4711

reviews.title: Still Fine, Even After the Rebranding
reviews.text: We flew to Beirut from Zurich in October 2019, and the flight was fine on the way in and back. The seats are pretty cramped but anyway it's not a long-haul carrier. The carry-on luggage is a comically disgustingly bad 6 kg limit, but actually we did not have to weigh bags in either direction. If they had cared about the bag weight, I would have probably given them 2* and never flown Chair again, because 6kg is an absurdly low carryon weight limit. One comment about the previous rating just below mine: there were major protests in Lebanon (including small riots) on the day of his flight, so the delay of the flight by 8 hours is.... not really Chair Airlines' fault, although I guess they could have been nice and issued a refund, but some other airlines completely cancelled their flights to Beirut that day, and many travellers cancelled their plans last-minute. Anyway I'd definitely fly Chair again if it was a direct flight to where I wanted to go. The planes are much more crowded than Swiss, but it sure beats having to take a connecting flight.
reviews.author: egw

reviews.title: Stay Away - Unreliable Flight Times & Poor Customer Service
reviews.text: Booked a flight with Chair from Zurich to Beirut. Chair informed me of a flight time change of 7h (!) from 1:20 PM to 6:20AM, which made it impossible for me to take the flight as I would not have been able to reach the airport on time in the morning without staying in Zurich over night (and paying for a hotel!). When I explained this to the company, they refused to refund me the ticket. Although in line with their T&Cs, this highly unreliable service is unacceptable. stay away if you want to reliably reach your destination at the time sold to you at the original purchase!
reviews.author: Julius4711

reviews.title: Bad Customer Service - Add on to earlier input "Ontime flight, nice and friendly crew"
reviews.text: In my 1st rating I did not mention that one of the suitecases arrived broken at Heraklion Airport. The fligth was on May, 24th 2019. Normally not a big thing. Report the damage at the airport, send in the required documents and then it will be settled. I'm still waiting for the money. I called the Call Center several times. Always the same comment on our side everything is ok - it is now with the accounting department. I got a mail - that the money will be transfered in the next couple of days, on the phone they told me next week - nothing happened so far. I even wrote two letters to the CEO of Chair, sent them by postmail - no reaction at all. I think this is definitely not good customer service. As mentioned in my 1st rating the Quality of the flight, the crew and the snacks were really good. It is a pitty that the backoffice guys ruin the good work and the impression I got on my trip.
reviews.author: Marcel B

reviews.title: Ontime flight, nice and friendly crew
reviews.text: 1st positvie surprise was on boarding. The offered free newspapers. the 2nd - The sandwich offered was from a local SME business which has a very good reputation for quality food. The crew was nice and the fligth on time.
reviews.author: Marcel B

reviews.title: Good service from beginning to end
reviews.text: We flew with Germania from Zurich to Hurghada and back. Flights were at end of April and mid May 2019. We were 3 adults, a child and an infant (on lap). Both flights were non-eventful with nothing to complain about. The service was good - check-in staff and on board. As with most of the chartered flights, a free meal (both times vegetarian pasta) was served during the flight and non-alcoholic drinks were served. The drinks were offered regularly and was also available continuously at the front and back of the plane (self-service). Alcoholic drinks were offered at a charge. They also offered a meal to my infant baby - this was a nice gesture which I have not seen before. Entertainment: one movie was shown on screens popping out from the overhead lockers (no personal screens). You could plug your earphones into the armrest for audio. Earphones were also sold on board - best to bring your own. Only negative: leg space is very limited for a 4-5 hour flight (it seemed to be like the standard short-haul flights). Tall people might become quite uncomfortable in the small space, so I would not want to fly more than 5 hours with this flight.
reviews.author: Oreo-X

reviews.title: Great service - friendly crew - no delays
reviews.text: After Gemania Germany went broke, we were a bit sceptical about our flights, already booked with Germania Switzerland. Via their helpline, we were reassured that our flights would remain unaffected - and indeed, they took place as scheduled. The service on board is great: something to drink and food were included. We enjoyed our flight very much and can only recommend Germania!
reviews.author: Dutchy in the Mountains

reviews.title: 7 HOURS DELAY... DON'T BOOK WITH GERMANIA
reviews.text: Don't book with Germania Switzerland, because we had 7 hours delay to go to Egypt and 7 hours delay to come back to Switzerland ! I receive a mail 3 days before... but no message with excuses. It was too much stress for vacation with a little boy.
